content.title: Pull Requests: Let Other Engineers Read the Change
content.hook: A pull request is more than a button that says “merge.”
content.context:
It is a review surface.

A useful pull request should help another engineer answer:

- What changed?
- Why did it change?
- What should I pay attention to?
- How can I verify the behavior?
goals: Understand the purpose of pull requests as a structured place to review and discuss a proposed change before integration.

content.question:
Title:

```text
updates
```

Description:

```text
did some stuff
```

What is missing?

options.text: Context about the change and how to verify it.

feedback.correct: Reviewers need enough context to reason about the proposed change.
feedback.incorrect: Reviewers need enough context to reason about the proposed change.

content.title: Write a useful pull request
content.text:
Suppose you fixed a search box that failed when the input was empty.

A clearer title is:

```text
Handle empty search input
```

A useful description might say:

```text
Problem
The search action could run with an empty input.

Change
Skip the request when the input is empty and show the existing empty-state message.

Verify
1. Open the search page.
2. Submit with an empty field.
3. Confirm no request is sent and the empty state is shown.
```

Notice what this does: it turns review from “look at my files” into a shared reasoning task.

activities.title: Review the change, not the person

content.title: Review the change, not the person
content.text:
A review comment should point to behavior, maintainability, correctness, or risk.

Better:

> “Could we avoid duplicating this condition? The same rule appears in the branch above.”

Worse:

> “This is bad code.”

Good engineering communication is specific enough to act on.

content.question:
A pull request changes 14 files but the stated feature should only require 2.

What is the most useful first question?

options.text: “Why are these other files part of the change?”
“Can we make the title all caps?”

feedback.correct: Scope is a review signal. Unexpected changes deserve investigation.
feedback.incorrect: Scope is a review signal. Unexpected changes deserve investigation.

content.question:
A good pull request reduces reviewer guesswork.

Which three pieces of information matter most?

options.text: Why, what changed, how to verify.
Developer age, keyboard brand, favorite editor.
Number of commits, line count, branch color.

feedback.correct: Correct answer: A. Why, what changed, how to verify.
feedback.incorrect: Correct answer: A. Why, what changed, how to verify.
